question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Extravagance
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4, **"Self-indulgence".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Extravagance**: (फिजूलखर्ची) - Lack of restraint in spending money or using resources; an act or a thing costing more than one can afford or is necessary.

 
 
• **Example**: The billionaire's party was criticized for its sheer extravagance.
 
 
 
• **Self-indulgence: **(आत्म-सुख) - Excessive or unrestrained gratification of one's own appetites, desires, or whims.
 
 
• **Example**: His penchant for gourmet food and fine wine was seen as a form of self-indulgence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Self-indulgence".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simplicity**: (सादगी) - The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do; the quality of being plain or natural.
 
• **Love**: (प्रेम) - An intense feeling of deep affection.
 
• **Fortune**: (भाग्य) - Chance or luck as an arbitrary force affecting human affairs; also can refer to a large amount of money or assets.
